name: aside
description: The chat pane of an app window (e2e/aside.e2e.ts). A prompt containing "explain this" proves the app context arrived: the desktop state of the prompt must carry `appContext` with the open file and the selection, and the short answer names the file. A prompt containing "summarise" answers for the Browser pane. Anything else gets a one-line answer.

steps.text: Short answer: {{file}} exports a small constant and a function that returns it.
Short answer: a short summary of the page in view.
